preamble: Editorial still-life photography on a seamless warm off-white cyclorama. Large soft overhead source, huge white bounce, near-shadowless with one soft contact shadow. High key, gentle contrast, warm white and pale neutral grade. Medium-format sharpness, fine grain. Photographic realism, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: A hairdresser's workstation in a bright calm salon, seen straight on from chest height. On a plain warm off-white plaster wall hangs a large round frameless mirror with a warm LED halo glowing softly behind its edge, a gentle warm glow spreading on the wall around it; the mirror reflects only the bright opposite wall and soft window light, nobody in it. Under the mirror a floating shelf of pale oak with the tools of the trade neatly laid out: slim silver scissors, a black carbon comb, a compact black hair clipper, a round wooden brush, two amber glass spray bottles and one frosted white bottle without labels, a folded cream cotton towel, a small clear glass vase with a sprig of eucalyptus. Below the shelf plain wall and a light oak floor. Bright soft daylight from tall windows out of frame on the left, warm white grade, near-shadowless. The mirror and the shelf sit in the right half of the frame, the mirror centred vertically with plain empty wall above it in the upper quarter; the whole left half of the frame is plain empty pale wall and floor, large empty space for text. No chair, no people, no reflections of people, no posters, no text, no signs, no logos, no labels on the bottles.

Portrait framing of the same hairdresser's workstation as the reference image: the same large round frameless mirror with a warm LED halo on the plain warm off-white wall, the same pale oak floating shelf with the same tools laid out (silver scissors, black comb, black clipper, round wooden brush, amber and frosted bottles without labels, folded cream towel, glass vase with eucalyptus), light oak floor below. Camera straight on from chest height, the mirror and shelf centred in the frame, plain empty wall above the mirror in the upper quarter, floor in the lower fifth. Same bright soft daylight from the left, near-shadowless, warm white grade. No chair, no people, no reflections of people, no text, no signs, no logos, no labels.

Wide interior of a small bright hair salon: three identical styling chairs with black leather seats in a row in front of three large round frameless mirrors on a plain warm off-white wall, a pale wooden counter under the mirrors, light oak floor. Seen straight on from the middle of the room, camera at chest height. Bright soft daylight from large windows out of frame, near-shadowless, warm white grade. The chairs and mirrors occupy the lower two thirds of the frame; the upper third is plain pale wall, empty space for text. No people, no reflections of people in the mirrors, no posters, no text, no signs, no logos, no plants.

No faces at all, heads out of frame. Warm off-white cyclorama behind, the hairdresser in a plain white cotton shirt. The hands and hair sit in the lower two thirds of the frame; the upper third is plain pale cyclorama, empty space for text. No text, no logos, no jewelry, no watches.

No text, no logos, no packaging, no jewelry.

The objects sit in the lower two thirds of the frame; the upper third is plain pale cyclorama, empty space for text. No people, no hands, no text, no labels, no logos.
